metadata.source_review_scope: Source-validate folded-protein-looking canonical ePK ligand rows that had no within-6-Angstrom heteromeric acceptor hit.

reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: Nearest heteromeric eIF2alpha Ser48 OG is 12.041 Angstrom from the closest PKR ANP PG despite local Mg.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title and primary citation identify a PKR kinase domain, eIF2alpha, and AMP-PNP complex with higher-order substrate recognition context.

reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: KSR2 ATP PG has local Mg but nearest MEK1 Ser/Thr/Tyr acceptor is 13.709 Angstrom away; MEK1 ATP PG has no local metal and nearest KSR2 acceptor is 14.720 Angstrom away.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title identifies the KSR2-MEK1 heterodimer; the primary citation reports a Raf-induced allosteric transition stimulating KSR/Raf phosphorylation of MEK.

reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: RIP3 ANP PG has local Mg, but the nearest MLKL Thr235 OG1 acceptor is 13.183 Angstrom away.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title identifies the mouse RIP3-MLKL complex; the primary citation is structural insight into RIP3-mediated necroptotic signaling.

reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: MST2 ANP PG local-metal instances have nearest RASSF5 hydroxyl acceptors at 24.339-26.102 Angstrom, outside local transfer geometry.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title identifies human MST2 kinase autoactivation and regulation by RASSF5, not a local transfer-state substrate complex.

reviewed_rows.candidate_context: non-ePK substrate complex returned by broad EC/Pfam-adjacent surface
reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: The isocitrate dehydrogenase kinase/phosphatase ATP/Mg donors are 13.670-87.555 Angstrom from heteromeric acceptors in the substrate enzyme.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title identifies an E. coli isocitrate dehydrogenase kinase/phosphatase-substrate complex rather than a canonical ePK kinase-substrate transfer state.

reviewed_rows.candidate_context: kinase-only ABA receptor phosphorylation source title
reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: No heteromeric substrate chain is modeled; the CARK1 ANP PG atoms have local Mg but no heteromeric acceptor to measure.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title says CARK1 phosphorylates ABA receptors, but the model contains only the Arabidopsis protein kinase superfamily protein chains plus ANP/Mg.

reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: PINK1 ANP PG has two local Mg ions, but no heteromeric substrate chain or acceptor is modeled.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title identifies a PINK1 kinase domain AMP-PNP complex; the primary citation concerns ubiquitin phosphorylation by PINK1, but this structure has no ubiquitin substrate chain.

reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: MST2 ANP PG has local Mg, but the nearest SAV1 hydroxyl acceptor is 33.548 Angstrom away.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title identifies human MST2 in complex with the SAV1 SARAH domain; this is regulatory activation context rather than a local transfer-state substrate complex.

reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: Legacy ANP PB fallback places the nearest Par3 Ser12 OG 6.053 Angstrom from the terminal atom, just outside the lane bound; this remains an inhibitory/access-control peptide context.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title and primary citation identify a Par3-inhibitory peptide bound to PKCiota core kinase domain to control substrate access.

reviewed_rows.candidate_context: repeat full-length substrate positive-like geometry without local metal
reviewed_rows.geometry_negative_reason: Cofilin Ser3 is 4.236 Angstrom from LIMK1 ANP PG, but no Mg/Mn is local to that ANP PG under the lane scan.
reviewed_rows.source_mapping: RCSB title and primary citation identify LIMK1 mutant D460N in complex with full-length cofilin-1 and noncanonical substrate recognition, matching prior lane review-only positive-like evidence.

evidence_against: Folded-protein-looking canonical ligand rows did not provide clean positive geometry: 2A19, 2Y4I, 4M69, and 4LGD all have source-relevant complex context but nearest heteromeric acceptors are at least 12.041 Angstrom from the kinase terminal phosphate.
3LCB is an out-of-scope/non-ePK kinase-phosphatase substrate complex and is also geometry-negative.

The offset50 source checks added no clean positives: 5XD6 and 5YJ9 have no modeled substrate chain, 6AO5 is distant regulatory context, 5LI1 is a 6.053 Angstrom inhibitory-peptide near miss, and 5HVK remains a no-local-metal repeat.
These source checks reinforce that canonical EC/Pfam plus ATP/ANP/Mg filters still need geometry and source validation before any label use.
source_review_summary.recommendation: Treat these folded-complex rows as review-only negatives for clean local transfer-state evidence. Do not activate production labels, thresholds, registries, fingerprints, migrations, or scoring.
